# Every optimum rebuilds a depleted base

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Below a level out of one step's reach, where the next level and the weighted gain rise with the level, every optimum of a far-sighted order rebuilds the base as fast as it renews, drawing nothing, and restores every dependence whose need the rising level meets.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A course gains the most where at each step to the n-th its level gains, weighted, at least what the level of any course open from s does; open and leaving nothing, it is an optimum of the weighted draw, and every optimum of every order rising with it leaves nothing weighted and gains what it does; a course of greatest weighted gain is the case. (`Becoming.Optimum.GainsMost`, `Becoming.Optimum.gainsMost_of_greatest`, `Becoming.Optimum.frontier_of_gainsMost`, `Becoming.Optimum.frontier_gains_of_most`)
2. The rising course from s rises as fast as what is given allows up to y: it stands at most at y, stays there once there, and draws nothing at a step after which it is below y; the rebuilding course stands there to the n-th step and at nothing after, and from s at most y, where z + R z rises with z below y, it is open with a capacity covering y + R y and R 0. (`Becoming.Optimum.rise`, `Becoming.Optimum.rebuilding`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rise_succ`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rise_le`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rise_le_top`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rise_within`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rise_of_below`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rise_at_top`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rise_below_before`, `Becoming.Optimum.rise_stays`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rebuilding_before`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rebuilding_after`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rebuilding_at`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rebuilding_within`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rebuilding_le_cap`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rebuilding_open`)
3. Where z + R z rises with z below y, every course from s at most y whose steps leave at most the level with what is given stands at each step at or below the rising course, or that course stands at y; so where the weighted gain rises with the level up to y and is greatest at y, the rebuilding course gains the most and is an optimum. (`Becoming.Optimum.Next.le_rise`, `Becoming.Optimum.Next.rebuilding_gainsMost`, `Becoming.Optimum.rebuilding_frontier`)
4. Where the gain rises strictly below y, every optimum stands at the rising course's level, drawing nothing at the step before, at every step to the n-th where that level is below y, and restores within those steps every dependence, as it stands at the start, whose need that level meets; where y gains more than every other level, every optimum stands at y where the rising course does. (`Becoming.Optimum.frontier_rebuilds`, `Becoming.Optimum.frontier_rebuilt`, `Becoming.Web.frontier_rebuilds`)
5. Witness: a source doubling up to eight, from one, capacity sixteen, over n + 3 steps: where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum draws nothing at the first two steps, stands at two, four, then eight, and restores the dweller at the first step; where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending at once is an optimum too; where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends it. (`Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.twice_mul`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_gain_le`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_gain_lt`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_low`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_high`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_grows`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_rises`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_rises_strictly`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_top`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_outpaced`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_outpaced_le`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.mul_lt_of_pos`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_above`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_rebuilds`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Discrete steps, natural amounts, natural weights. Courses open from s at most y; a renewal law R with z + R z rising with z below y; n + 1 steps; the weighted gain rising with the level up to y (strictly, for every optimum) and greatest at y (more than every other level, for standing at y); a capacity covering y + R y and R 0.
- For the web law, a dependence on the condition as it stands at the start. Which formation optimizes, by which order, weighting, capacity and horizon, and the renewal law are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The optimum where the next level does not rise with the level below y (an overcompensating renewal) or the gain has several peaks; that the rising course is then not an optimum.
- A dependence needing more than y restored; an order valuing what is left at the horizon; steps met again after a fall; several optimizers ranking courses.
- That a base ought to be rebuilt: no evaluation enters; the laws say what the optima of an order do.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The most rapid approach path: with a linear objective, the optimal path from a stock below its optimal level harvests nothing until the level is reached, then holds it (Spence and Starrett 1975; Clark 1976). On the spine every optimum of every order rising with the weighted draw rebuilds, under any weighting whose gain rises with the level; the reference is any course gaining the most against every open course, the earlier holding laws its case; the restoration of what depends on the base is a law of the dependence web; the witness shows the strict premise needed. Reading (the AI's): far-sight repairs damage to its own base where its weighting falls slower than the base renews, up to the level its order favours.
